comparison.objective: Hold a cord taut and cut it safely with a knife.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual tensioning, blade control, safe separation, and deformable-object handling.
comparison.success_condition: Cord cut while held taut and at safe distances; knife set down without blade contact or dropped objects.
comparison.reason: Its defining ability is tension-assisted cutting with blade safety, unrelated to rigid guide alignment and bearing-element containment.
